s.zh: 点击切换：无兴趣 → 单火 → 双火。双火最多3项，单火不限。已选双火：
s.en: Click to cycle: no passion → minor → major. Up to 3 major passions, minor unlimited. Major passions chosen:

s.zh: 当前实际技能兴趣；初始配置在唤醒时应用，后续变化由游戏正常记录。
s.en: Current actual skill passions; the initial configuration is applied on awakening, and later changes are recorded by the game as usual.

s.zh: 知识死灵技能固定，兴趣只决定传给主人的经验。
s.en: Knowledge necro skills are fixed; passions only decide the XP passed to the master.
